baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِزَاجُ at word 1 names the admixture, while مِن تَسْنِيمٍ at word 3 gives its origin.
baseline_models.mechanism: A substance is mixed into another, and that substance is drawn from a rising or elevated source; height is therefore part of the drink's material supply chain.

activation_trace.role: Mixing one thing with another supplies the literal admixture and makes Tasnim the added constituent.
Rising and elevation, including water emerging above ground, locates the constituent in a vertically emergent source.

changed_reading.before: The drink has a vaguely exalted flavoring.
changed_reading.after: Its actual blending constituent is sourced from a rising, elevated supply.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive مِزَاجُهُ and source construction مِن تَسْنِيمٍ attach elevation to internal composition rather than merely to location.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mixing transfers properties across substances. With Tasnim imaged as raised terrain, the construction makes what is spatially high enter and qualify what is drunk: elevation becomes ingestible.

activation_trace.role: Material intermixture supplies the transfer by which a source quality can enter the drink.
Raised backs of earth and sand make height a concrete source-property transferred by the mixture.

changed_reading.before: Tasnim is simply a high place associated with the drink.
changed_reading.after: What is high is incorporated into the drink; elevation functions as a consumable quality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of مِزَاجُ includes bodily temperament and constitution, still anchored to the focus noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: If mizaj names constitution as well as recipe, Tasnim's ascent is a formative input: the drink's constitution, and potentially the drinker's through ingestion, is founded on elevation.

activation_trace.role: Bodily temperament and composition opens a constitutive rather than merely culinary sense of mizaj.
Ascent and emergence supply the quality on which that constitution is formed.

changed_reading.before: The noun describes only what is in the cup.
changed_reading.after: It can also describe a constitution formed from ascent, with incorporation into the drinker left live but unproven.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus branch names mazj as honey, while Tasnim remains the explicitly elevated source.
baseline_models.mechanism: The admixture can carry a honeyed material image: sweetness or honey-like density comes from the rising source rather than from an unspecified additive.

activation_trace.role: Honey called mazj supplies a concrete sweet and viscous candidate for the admixture.
Elevation supplies the honey-like material's marked origin.

changed_reading.after: A honey-like admixture from the elevated source remains a live material reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening opposition between full receipt and deficient giving recasts mixing as proportion. Tasnim is not a cheap diluent but the fully delivered, balanced share that enters the drink, and fullness itself has a branch that reaches an overlooking height.

activation_trace.role: Literal intermixture creates the compositional ratio that the metrological context can recalibrate.
Measuring food supplies the concrete act of apportioning a consumable substance.
Completion without deficiency makes the high-source portion a full grant rather than dilution.
Reaching an elevation from which one overlooks unexpectedly joins fulfilled measure to Tasnim's height.
Balancing two things supplies the compositional relation between base drink and admixture.
Shorting measure defines the rejected counter-model: a mixture that cheats its recipient.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 contrasts taking in full with giving by deficient measure.
The focus uses a composition noun followed by a min-source, allowing an apportioned share without stating a numeric recipe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, fullness, balance, loss, and a literal high-source admixture; I infer that the admixture performs just apportionment. A live alternative is that metrology frames justice globally without specifying the drink's proportions.

changed_reading.after: The mixture becomes an exact and non-deficient allotment of the elevated source, reversing the surah's opening short measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's split mapping for Rabb keeps both nurture/completion and increase/elevation/nourishment in play. Those branches make Tasnim's admixture an elevating nourishment that forms constitution, while being veiled from Rabb marks the negative condition of denied formative access.

activation_trace.role: Temperament and bodily composition provide the focus anchor for nourishment that reforms constitution.
Elevation supplies the direction and quality of the formative nourishment.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative action assigned to the admixture.
The retained non-dominant branch of increase and elevation converges directly on Tasnim's upward quality.
Nourishment and growth make denied access to Rabb a contrast with constitution nourished from elevation.

structural_cues: Rabb occurs at the universal standing in 83:6 and as the one from whom the other group is veiled in 83:15.
The packet explicitly preserves the non-dominant r-b-w inventory for this split root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, completion, increase, elevation, and growth under the split mapping; I infer that the high admixture enacts nurturing ascent. The live alternative is accidental branch convergence, leaving Tasnim only a source name.

changed_reading.before: The high-source constituent changes only taste or recipe.
changed_reading.after: It can nourish an upward constitution, making access to elevation formative rather than decorative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked record is established and witnessed; the selected drink is securely sealed; the focus names its source; and the next ayah identifies a flowing spring. Together these turn مِن تَسْنِيمٍ into a compact provenance claim for the admixture.

activation_trace.role: The added substance is the material whose origin must remain traceable.
The named elevated source is the provenance endpoint.
An established record carrying binding determination supplies documentary fixation.
An inscribed mark in a record supplies an origin mark rather than an anonymous mixture.
Presence with observation supplies witnessing of the upper record and its associated source order.
A secure preventing seal protects the drink against an untracked substitution.
A spring of running water resolves the named provenance into a continuing source.

structural_cues: The paired records in 83:7-9 and 83:18-21 are both marked, but only the upper record is immediately witnessed by the brought-near.
83:25-28 sequences sealed drink, aromatic finish, named admixture, and spring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record, mark, witness, secure seal, named origin, and spring; I infer a chain of provenance across those elements. A live alternative is that records and drink are parallel guarantees rather than one shared authentication mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Tasnim authenticates origin: the sealed drink's admixture is traceable to a witnessed, flowing source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first shows acquisition coating hearts, then shows bliss as recognizable facial radiance. The competition root opens draught, life, and temperament, while the following drinking branch explicitly joins color with heart. This activates the focus constitution branch as a counter-process: elevated admixture enters inward temperament and surfaces as color.

activation_trace.role: Bodily temperament and composition make the focus mixture capable of describing inward constitution.
Elevation gives that constitution its upward source-quality.
The core or essence supplies the inward site whose acquired condition can be counter-formed.
Beauty and radiance supply the visible outward result of the proposed inner change.
A draught or gulp keeps the competition wording materially connected to ingestion.
Strength and temperament of the self name the inward faculty reconstituted by the drink.
Intermixture of color and heart supplies the explicit bridge from drinking to inward and outward transformation.

structural_cues: 83:14 gives a causal surface sequence from what was earned to a condition on hearts.
83:24 makes bliss recognizable on faces, and 83:25-28 places the focus inside the drinking sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative acquired heart-condition, positive visible radiance, temperament, and a drinking branch that mixes color with heart; I infer a symmetric positive arrow from high-source drink to inner constitution and face. A live alternative is that radiance accompanies bliss independently of the drink.

changed_reading.before: The mixture describes composition inside the cup.
changed_reading.after: The elevated admixture can cross into heart and temperament and become visible as radiance, countering the acquired coating of the other group.

context_deltas.mechanism: An upper register is witnessed by the brought-near; the righteous are served a drink whose admixture comes from Tasnim; then a spring is drunk from or by the brought-near. Mixture mediates the elevated source across degrees of proximity: a served portion for one group coexists with direct source-contact for the nearer group.

activation_trace.role: Intermixture is the material means by which access to one source can be mediated into another drink.
Elevation aligns Tasnim with the upper register and supplies the vertical source.
The upper direction and what is above establish a prior vertical register for Tasnim.
The favored status of those brought near supplies a social degree of access, not distance alone.
An allotted share of water and its channel make service a mediated distribution from a source.
The flowing spring turns Tasnim's elevation into a drinkable source rather than status alone.
A share of water preserves apportioned participation while the brought-near drink at the source.
Near contact and involvement sharpen the brought-near group's relation to the spring itself.

structural_cues: 83:18-21 moves from the upper register to its witnessing by the brought-near.
83:22-28 moves from the righteous being served to the admixture's source and the brought-near drinking there.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical rank, favored nearness, service, mixture, spring, and drinking; I infer differentiated mediation, with the righteous receiving Tasnim through mixture and the nearer having source-contact. A live alternative is that 83:28 describes shared access without an exclusive tier.

changed_reading.before: The mixture is merely a recipe shared without social structure.
changed_reading.after: It is a hydraulic-social bridge: the righteous participate in the elevated source through admixture while the brought-near drink in immediate relation to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A selected pure drink is securely sealed and held, yet its admixture is from a flowing spring. The apparent purity/mixing tension resolves if the added source is itself protected and select: mixing completes the drink without contaminating it.

activation_trace.role: Literal mixing creates the apparent tension with the preceding selected pure drink.
The rising source supplies a second select liquid rather than an inferior diluent.
A pure selected wine establishes the quality that the admixture must preserve.
The secure seal supplies protection against contamination before service.
A place that holds water supplies protected containment alongside the literal musk finish.
The flowing spring identifies a continuing clean supply for the protected mixture.

structural_cues: 83:25 calls the drink selected and sealed before 83:27 calls it mixed.
83:28 immediately recasts the named elevated term as a spring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selected purity, secure containment, literal mixing, and a flowing source; I infer that source-quality resolves rather than cancels purity. A live alternative is conventional flavoring in which purity and mixture are not intended as a tension.

changed_reading.before: Adding a mixture appears to dilute the pure sealed drink.
changed_reading.after: A protected admixture from an equally privileged source completes the drink while preserving its purity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Full delivery at the opening, reckoning in the middle, and recompense returning to the doer at the close activate the rare giving branch of mizaj. The Tasnim portion can therefore be heard not only as ingredient but as a fully returned gift or awarded share.

activation_trace.role: Giving an asker something turns the focus noun toward granted share while remaining inside its branch inventory.
The elevated source specifies what is granted rather than leaving the gift abstract.
Full delivery without lack defines the completeness of the granted portion.
Accounting and recompense supply the legal return structure behind the gift.
The reward of an act returning to its agent supplies the final direction of return.
The production of an act supplies what the returning recompense answers.

structural_cues: The surah opens with asymmetric giving and ends by asking whether deeds have been repaid.
The focus possessive can hold together material composition and the recipient's awarded portion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full delivery, reckoning, return-reward, action, and a focus branch of giving; I infer that the admixture is also an awarded share. A live alternative is that recompense governs the scene generally but does not alter the lexical force of mizaj.

changed_reading.before: The Tasnim portion is accidental recipe information.
changed_reading.after: It can also be the fully delivered gift that returns to its recipients as recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The honey reading is surprising because the witnessing root, not the drink vocabulary, supplies honey in wax; it remains valid because the focus mizaj inventory independently names honey and the drink is sealed. Render only as a convergent material resonance, not as proof that Tasnim literally is honey.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier remains anchored in the focus branch that names mazj as honey and in Tasnim's elevated origin.

activation_trace.role: Honey called mazj supplies the focus's direct honey-like material possibility.
Elevation preserves the explicit source relation for the honeyed material.
Honey held in wax gives the witnessing scene an unexpected honeycomb material echo.
Secure sealing lets the wax-enclosure image converge with the protected drink.

changed_reading.after: A contained honey or honeycomb-like sweetness from elevation coexists with the hydraulic reading.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and form-distant: drink language activates crop, dye, and plant branches. It remains anchored because focus branches pair grain color-change with a raised plant head, while nearby branches add wheat, first watering, and radiance. Render as a vegetal overlay in which the drink ripens or colors its recipient, never as the focus's exclusive lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus itself joins mizaj as a grain's color transition to Tasnim as the raised head of a plant.

activation_trace.role: Grain turning from green toward yellow supplies the focus's maturation and color-change image.
The raised head of a plant supplies the vegetal form from which that maturation is sourced.
Grain or wheat places the righteous themselves inside the surrounding crop resonance.
Radiance supplies the visible color-result analogous to ripening.
Pouring color into cloth makes the served liquid a coloring agent, not only hydration.
Sealing a crop with its first watering turns the drink's finish into an agricultural completion cue.

changed_reading.before: The focus only reports a beverage recipe.
changed_reading.after: It can also overlay an irrigation-ripening process: elevation enters as liquid and makes matured color visible in the recipient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because non-dominant split mappings from knowing, reciting, and saying supply outflow, pouring, hill, vessel, summit, and jar. It remains packet-valid because those mapped targets are explicitly retained and converge on the focus's own mixing/elevation mechanism. Render as an abductive hydraulic echo, with the form-distance stated, not as derivation of the surface verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus already provides a mixed substance and a rising source; the split-root images only sharpen its topology into elevated reservoir, pour, and vessel.

activation_trace.role: Literal mixing anchors every borrowed hydraulic image in the focus composition.
Rising and emergent water anchor the reservoir's elevation in the focus.
Profuse issuing from a source turns the upper-register knowledge formula into an unexpected flow activator.
The retained hill branch adds an elevated reservoir form to the recitation cue.
Pouring and pushing supplies the directional transfer from high source into mixture.
A drinking vessel supplies the receiving container for the pour.
A summit reinforces the vertical origin through the non-dominant mapped root.
A large jar completes the reservoir-and-vessel topology activated around the focus.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names a source but leaves transfer mechanics unstated.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant but coherent branch network pictures profuse liquid poured from an elevated reservoir into a receiving drink.

strongest_changes: The following spring and brought-near group turn mixture into graded access to one elevated source.
Heart, temperament, color, and radiance turn cup composition into an inward constitution that becomes outwardly visible.
Opening measure and the record-mark-witness-seal sequence make the Tasnim portion a full, authenticated allotment rather than cheap dilution.
Honey, crop-ripening, and split-root hydraulics remain live as contained branch resonances instead of being normalized away.
summary.what_was_special: The focus makes elevation materially incorporable. Context then lets the same admixture coexist as source-water, social access, formative nourishment, visible transformation, just allotment, authenticated provenance, honeyed substance, and ripening liquid without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مِن primarily marks source, partitive content, or both, and whether بِهَا in 83:28 implies direct source-access or only instrumental drinking.
Whether the constitution branch applies first to the drink itself or can legitimately extend through ingestion to the drinker.
Whether honey, crop, and non-dominant split-root vessel images are intended material mechanisms or productive but accidental activation.
